utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still piecing together the details, but I heard the repair drive is soon and near the community center. If you know the drop-off spot, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll pass along anything I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and mention it to the others so the repair drive keeps moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s still set for Sunday at the community center. I’ll send any extra details if I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’ll plan for Sunday at the community center. If you hear the time or any parking details, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m definitely available to help with the repair drive. Just let me know the details and what you’d like me to do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — I’m at the hardware store now asking about donated supplies, and I’ll pass along whatever I can get for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Just let me know what they can donate, and I’ll be ready to help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli. Bring it by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll write up a simple list of what needs fixing and when we’re meeting, then I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be ready when you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I’m still a bit fuzzy on the repair drive details. If you hear where the drop-off spot is, let me know?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure—I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the drop-off spot sorted out. I’m still gathering the repair-drive details, but I should have them by later today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out for the drop-off spot later today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already — folks seem eager to help. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful to hear, Tess — thank you. I’ll keep the updated details handy in case anyone asks: Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sunday at the community center — I’ll pass that along. Thanks, Rosa, and I’ll let you know if I hear any other updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll check what supplies we already have and put together a quick list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll mention it to the others and keep the repair drive moving. Let me know who’s bringing what once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—9 a.m. still works for me. I’m a bit behind on the details, but I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — that helps. If you hear the exact drop-off spot near the community center, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — if I hear the exact drop-off spot near the community center, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — send them over, and I’ll make sure everything is powered down first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll send the homes and supplies over shortly. Just let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m definitely available to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be ready for the fix list around 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading past the shops now, so I’ll ask about the drop-off spot and any spare parts for the repair drive.

utterances.text: Faye: 9 a.m. works for me—I can line up the school pickups around that. Do you want me to coordinate anything else for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—could you confirm the supply list and let me know if you need me to help set up before 9?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please send the supply list when you can, and if you’re free before 9, a little setup help would be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help fill any gaps—what’s still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I can help with the parts list or run errands if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Kira — I can bring the tools and help however I can for the repair drive. Just let me know what you’re able to get from the store.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus — just confirming, you’re definitely bringing the tools, right? I’ll handle the store run and let you know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the tools and be there to help. Just keep me posted if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m spreading the word to the regular helpers and a few handy folks right now. Saturday’s repair drive should have a solid crew.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that’s awesome. I can keep lining up anyone else you need and ask around for extra tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be perfect, Jules — keep them coming. I’ll keep inviting folks and should have us set for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’ll sort the list once you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — I’ll send it over as soon as I get it. Sounds like we’re in good shape for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll be ready for the list and will sort it as soon as it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m ready to help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. If you can help sort or carry items, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I can help sort and carry items; just tell me what time to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I can help update the list and drop-off timing. Just send me who needs what when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll bring the repair-drive details by later today once I’ve sorted them out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when you drop them off.
